snippet.title: 【Official】[Seven Knights Re:BIRTH] Story Cinematic - Prologue
snippet.description:
100 Million Hearts, A Legacy Reborn!
Grand Launch on September 18th (KST)!

Pre-register now to receive
Seven Knights Rachel, Four Lords Ace, and more amazing rewards!

▶ Go to pre-register: https://sena.netmarble.com/en/preorder

-------------------------------------------------------

In an event from the past...
As the God of Destruction's revival becomes imminent,
Silvesta and Teo decide to attack the God of Destruction with all their might.
